title.zh: Cu Barrier失效会沿两条路径放大
title.en: Cu barrier failure amplifies along two paths

subtitle.zh: 一条伤导电，一条伤绝缘；最终才在电阻或可靠性上暴露
subtitle.en: One harms conduction, the other insulation; resistance or reliability reveals the outcome

body.zh: 健康参考；连续Barrier；+ 连续Seed；Low-k；TaN；Ta；Cu Seed；ECP Cu
body.en: Healthy reference Continuous barrier + continuous seed Low-k TaN Ta Cu seed ECP Cu

body.zh: 路径A|导电链断开；Cu Seed不连续
body.en: Path A | broken conduction chain Discontinuous Cu seed
Local failure to initiate plating / void
Higher line / via resistance

body.zh: 局部电流拥挤，；会放大EM风险；电流密度；（J）；高；低
body.en: Local current crowding amplifies EM risk Current density (J) High Low

body.zh: 注：EM（电迁移）由电流密度与材料/结构共同决定，非由Barrier单独导致。
body.en: Note: EM (electromigration) depends on current density and the material/structure, not solely on the barrier

body.zh: 路径B |绝缘屏障失守；TaN不连续/针孔
body.en: Path B | breached insulation barrier Discontinuous TaN / pinholes
Cu diffusion into low-k
Higher leakage and TDDB risk

body.zh: 扩散位置往往先于电性失效被看见；Low-k；TaN；Ta；Cu Seed；ECP Cu
body.en: The diffusion site often becomes visible before electrical failure Low-k TaN Ta Cu seed ECP Cu

body.zh: 界面缺陷；附着异常；分层；接触波动
body.en: Interface defects Adhesion anomaly Delamination Contact variation
